notes: Fleet git isolation, mechanized. Read AGENTS.md, DELEGATEE.md §committing, the brief. Evaluated the four options and recommended the commit wrapper (tools/git-commit-mine): worktrees ruled out because the kanban (docs/infra/managent/tasks.json) lives in the working tree and would fragment per worktree — a split-brain attribution ledger is a worse hazard than a polluted index, plus the merge step re-introduces absorption; the pre-commit subset check ruled out as primary because the hook cannot see `git commit` path args, the Orchestrator's integration scope is 'anything' so it needs an escape hatch (the rot point), and core.hooksPath is UNSET today (the T272 hook is not installed — T280's job), so it has a worse deployment record than a self-contained script; serialize-commits ruled out because it addresses index corruption, not absorption — under a lock, T272's staged files still land in T268's commit (catches none of the three incidents). Implemented: (1) tools/git-commit-mine — refuses pathless invocation, stages only named paths, refuses foreign staged content naming each path (incident-1 fixture reproduced in tools/regression-git-commit-mine.sh: two staged sets, one commit, refused, both sets intact), identity from --task/--bundle/MANAGENT_TASK_ID, --explicit path-limited mode for the Orchestrator; verify-after asserts the commit contains exactly the named paths. The first wrapper cut committed a plain `git commit` in explicit mode and ABSORBED the foreign files — the seeded fixture caught it (3 files in one commit); fixed with `git commit -- <paths>`; the fixture now asserts it. (2) managent done deliverable check now asks git (src/managent/main.zig cmdDone): tracked+clean passes; untracked refused naming the path; retention edge ruled: untracked/ + SHA256SUMS-pinned passes (ARGUS T211); deletion edge ruled: staged-but-uncommitted deletion refused, committed deletion passes via git log --diff-filter=D; rebuilt via tools/runner (ReleaseSafe) + deploy.sh, stamp 05dae9b-dirty; controls in tools/regression-managent-done-git.sh (null, seeded-untracked, seeded-modified, retention, deletion-both-states — all PASS); pre-existing integrity + memory-safety regressions PASS on the rebuilt binary. (3) bin/subagent sets MANAGENT_TASK_ID for dispatched workers (the per-console identity channel the runner already honors as --task-id fallback). (4) docs/status/CURRENT.md T278 ownership block. Not established: whether the Orchestrator will adopt the wrapper (second seat required — this doc is the proposal, verify-then-promote); the T272 hook remains uninstalled. Noticed but not acted on: (a) core.hooksPath unset means NO pre-commit gate exists today — flagging again for T280; (b) the shared index also means concurrent `git diff` calls from two consoles can transiently see an index.lock and my done-check would refuse-with-message (safe direction, not silent pass) — noted in the doc; (c) tasks.json and src/exp6_solve.zig were modified in the shared tree before/while I worked (exp6 is foreign — left untouched, not in the install graph so my build did not trip on it); (d) a path deleted in an OLD commit would pass the deletion acceptance vacuously if redeclared — flagged in the doc as auditor-follow-up. Committed path-limited: src/managent/main.zig, tools/git-commit-mine, tools/regression-git-commit-mine.sh, tools/regression-managent-done-git.sh, bin/subagent, docs/status/CURRENT.md, docs/infra/fleet-git-isolation.md, findings/T278-git-isolation.json. Recommended follow-up: T280 installs the T272 hook; a staged-path-subset check could ride it as the bypass-proof backstop for workers (env-var identity), with the wrapper remaining the Orchestrator's path-limited tool.
